* ==========================================================================
* Unregulated voltage-doubling (2x) charge pump - Sky130
* Interface: charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT
*
* Two-phase (ping-pong) doubler with explicitly driven switch gates.
*
*   phase A : BOT1 low  -> MC1 ties TOP1 to AVDD  (C1 charges to AVDD)
*             BOT2 high -> TOP2 boosted, MT2 dumps it into VOUT
*   phase B : mirror image
*
* Every switch is a PMOS with its gate driven rail-to-rail by a small
* inverter that is powered from a node guaranteed to be at or above the
* switch source, so no threshold drop appears in either the charge or the
* transfer path:
*   - transfer gate GTx is driven between AVSS and VOUT   (MTx source=VOUT)
*   - charge   gate GCx is driven between AVSS and TOPx   (MCx source=TOPx
*                                                          while boosted)
* With complete charge transfer the output settles at
*       VOUT = 2*AVDD - IOUT/(2*f*CFLY)
* CFLY is a MIM capacitor, which has no process or temperature corner
* dependence in this model set, and f is the external clock, so the
* switched-capacitor output resistance 1/(2*f*CFLY) is PVT invariant.
*
* EN=0 gates the clock at the input NAND (nothing toggles), and forces
* R1=R2 high so all four power switches turn on.  VOUT is then tied to
* AVDD through low ohmic switches, settles exponentially, and the only
* remaining supply current is device leakage.
* ==========================================================================
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT

* ---------------- clock gate: NG = !(CLK & EN) ----------------------------
* long channel devices: this is the only stage that sees a toggling CLK
* when EN=0, and its off device sets part of the powerdown leakage.
XPG1 NG   CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1    w=1  nf=1
XPG2 NG   EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1    w=1  nf=1
XNG1 NG   CLK NGM  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1    w=1  nf=1
XNG2 NGM  EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1    w=1  nf=1

* ---------------- phase splitter ------------------------------------------
XPS1 S1 NG AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=4 nf=1
XNS1 S1 NG AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=2 nf=1

XPS2 S2 S1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=4 nf=1
XNS2 S2 S1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- bottom plate drivers ------------------------------------
* PMOS is in the charge transfer path (kept moderate so the delivery
* current is spread over the phase -> small output ripple), NMOS is in the
* capacitor recharge path (kept strong so recharge completes).
XPB1 BOT1 S1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=4  nf=1
XNB1 BOT1 S1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=12 nf=3

XPB2 BOT2 S2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=4  nf=1
XNB2 BOT2 S2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=12 nf=3

* ---------------- fast replicas of BOT1 / BOT2 ----------------------------
* R1 = !(S1 & EN) = BOT1, R2 = !(S2 & EN) = BOT2 while enabled.
* Both go high when EN=0, which turns every power switch on.
XPR1A R1  S1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=2 nf=1
XPR1B R1  EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=2 nf=1
XNR1A R1  S1 R1M  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=3 nf=1
XNR1B R1M EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=3 nf=1

XPR2A R2  S2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=2 nf=1
XPR2B R2  EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=2 nf=1
XNR2A R2  S2 R2M  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=3 nf=1
XNR2B R2M EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=3 nf=1

* ---------------- flying capacitors ---------------------------------------
XCF1 TOP1 BOT1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=34.2 l=34.2 mult=1
XCF2 TOP2 BOT2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=34.2 l=34.2 mult=1

* ---------------- power switches ------------------------------------------
XMC1 TOP1 GC1 AVDD NW1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=5 nf=1
XMC2 TOP2 GC2 AVDD NW2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=5 nf=1

XMT1 TOP1 GT1 VOUT NW1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=2 nf=1
XMT2 TOP2 GT2 VOUT NW2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- transfer gate drivers (rail = VOUT) ---------------------
XGTP1 GT1 R1 VOUT NW1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XGTN1 GT1 R1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XGTP2 GT2 R2 VOUT NW2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XGTN2 GT2 R2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- charge gate drivers (rail = local top plate) ------------
XGCP1 GC1 R2 TOP1 NW1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XGCN1 GC1 R2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XGCP2 GC2 R1 TOP2 NW2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XGCN2 GC2 R1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- dynamic n-well bias: NWx = max(TOPx, VOUT) --------------
XMW1A NW1 VOUT TOP1 NW1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMW1B NW1 TOP1 VOUT NW1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMW2A NW2 VOUT TOP2 NW2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMW2B NW2 TOP2 VOUT NW2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- startup helper ------------------------------------------
* Guarantees a conducting AVDD->VOUT path for the dc operating point.
* Self cuts off once VOUT reaches AVDD-VTH and blocks reverse current
* afterwards (source becomes AVDD, VGS=0).  Off when EN=0.
XMSU AVDD EN VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

.ends charge_pump_unregulate

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump.
* Interface fixed by the task: AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT, active-high EN.
*
* Architecture
*   Two-phase cross-coupled doubler.  Each branch has a MIM flying cap whose
*   bottom plate is driven rail-to-rail by the gated clock; the top plate is
*   precharged to AVDD and boosted to 2*AVDD, and a PMOS transfer switch
*   dumps the packet into VOUT.  The two branches alternate, so VOUT receives
*   two charge packets per clock period and the ripple is halved.
*
*   Each branch also carries a small auxiliary boost cap (GA/GB).  That node
*   drives gate capacitance only, so unlike the main top plate it keeps a
*   full AVDD..2*AVDD swing while the main plate collapses into the load.
*   GA/GB supply a pair of thick-oxide inverters that produce the boosted
*   gate drives GDA/GDB, which swing AVSS..2*AVDD and control both the
*   precharge NMOS and the transfer PMOS of the opposite phase:
*     PHx low  -> GDx high -> precharge switch on, transfer switch hard off
*     PHx high -> GDx low  -> precharge switch off, transfer switch fully on
*   A full 0/2*AVDD gate drive is what makes the transfer complete: the top
*   plate equalises all the way down to VOUT instead of stalling one PMOS
*   threshold above the gate level.
*
*   The pump therefore runs charge-transfer limited and its unregulated
*   output settles at VOUT = 2*AVDD - Iload/(f*Cfly_total), set by the MIM
*   capacitance (corner independent in this PDK), the external clock and the
*   load rather than by any threshold voltage.  That keeps the output inside
*   2.2 V .. 2.8 V over the whole PVT set with no regulation loop.
*
*   GDA/GDB are taken from the pre-driver node so that the transfer switch
*   opens slightly before its bottom plate falls, which suppresses reverse
*   charge flow from VOUT back into the flying cap.
*
*   EN = 0 gates the clock at the first gate, parks every boosted node at
*   AVSS and leaves each AVDD path behind two stacked off devices.
*
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT
*
* ================= control =================
XMP0 ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN0 ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
*
* NGA = NAND(CLK,EN).  EN sits at the bottom of the NMOS stack so the stack
* node is not recycled out of AVDD on every clock edge while disabled.
XMP1 NGA CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMP2 NGA EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN1 NGA CLK NSA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN2 NSA EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
*
* NGB = NAND(NGA,EN): complementary phase, also parked high when disabled.
XMP3 NGB NGA AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMP4 NGB EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN3 NGB NGA NSB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN4 NSB EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
*
* ================= bottom plate drivers =================
* branch A: PHA = CLK.EN , branch B: PHB = /CLK.EN , both low when disabled
XMP5 A1 NGA AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMN5 A1 NGA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XMP6 A2 A1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMN6 A2 A1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMP7 PHA A2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=8
XMN7 PHA A2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
*
XMP8 B1 NGB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMN8 B1 NGB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XMP9 B2 B1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMN9 B2 B1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMPA PHB B2 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=8
XMNA PHB B2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
*
* ================= pump capacitors =================
* main flying caps 2.3 pF, auxiliary gate-boost caps 2.0 pF
XCA TA PHA sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=33.76 l=33.76
XCB TB PHB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=33.76 l=33.76
XCGA GA PHA sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=31.47 l=31.47
XCGB GB PHB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=31.47 l=31.47
* n-well hold cap keeps the transfer-switch body bias defined at crossover
XCNW NW AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=11.03 l=11.03
*
* ================= boosted gate drivers =================
* GDx = /PHx swinging AVSS..2*AVDD, supplied from the opposite boost node.
* Driven from the pre-driver node so the gate drive leads the bottom plate.
* Thick-oxide devices: these gates see the boosted rail.
XMGP1 GDA A1 GB GB sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMGN1 GDA A1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMGP2 GDB B1 GA GA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMGN2 GDB B1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
*
* ================= precharge =================
* header: connects the precharge rail to AVDD only while enabled
XMPH VPRE ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
* main top plates, hard on/off from the boosted gate drive
XMNC TA GDA VPRE AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMND TB GDB VPRE AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* auxiliary nodes: cross coupled so that the boost pair self starts
XMNG GA GB VPRE AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMNH GB GA VPRE AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
*
* ================= charge transfer =================
XMPC VOUT GDA TA NW sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
XMPD VOUT GDB TB NW sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
*
* transfer-switch n-well biased at max(GA,GB), i.e. always near 2*AVDD
XMPE NW GB GA NW sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMPF NW GA GB NW sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
*
* ================= standby parking =================
XMNE TA ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMNF TB ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMNI GA ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMNJ GB ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
*
* ================= start-up / dc bias definition =================
* Active only while enabled.  They give VOUT, the boosted nodes and the
* n-well a defined dc operating point (the ideal dc load would otherwise
* drive VOUT far negative before the first clock edge) and let the boost
* pair bootstrap.  Once their sources rise above AVDD they sit at VGS = 0.
XMSU AVDD EN VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMSA AVDD EN TA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMSB AVDD EN TB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMSC AVDD EN GA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMSD AVDD EN GB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMSE AVDD EN NW AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
.ends charge_pump_unregulate

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Unregulated 2x (voltage-doubling) charge pump, active-high enable.
*
*   .subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT
*
* Architecture
* ------------
*   AVDD -> [header] -> VDDI -> non-overlap clock + bottom-plate drivers
*   two flying MIM caps, cross-coupled NMOS pre-charge, cross-coupled high-Vt
*   PMOS charge transfer -> VP (pumped node, ~3.35 V) -> series poly resistor
*   -> VOUT.
*
* Why the level is set by a series resistor instead of by flying-cap droop:
*   A cross-coupled doubler gates each transfer PMOS with the opposite top
*   plate, whose low level is AVDD.  Near equilibrium the transfer device then
*   sees Vsg = VOUT - AVDD, so it switches off before the transfer completes
*   unless VOUT stays roughly a threshold above AVDD.  Running the pump close
*   to its 2*AVDD open-circuit value keeps every transfer complete, so the
*   pumped node is stiff and nearly PVT independent, and the ~1 V that has to
*   be shed to land inside the 2.2-2.8 V window is taken across a physical
*   poly resistor.  In this model set both the MIM capacitor and the poly
*   sheet resistance are corner independent, so VOUT moves only with the
*   resistor's small temperature coefficient.
*   The same resistor forms an RC low-pass with the 1 nF output load, which
*   attenuates the switching ripple by three orders of magnitude, and its
*   ~20 us time constant still settles well inside the 200 us window.
*
* Power-down: EN=0 gates the clock and opens a high-Vt supply header, so the
* entire switching core is isolated from AVDD by two stacked off devices.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT

* --- enable inverter: sits on AVDD permanently, so make it minimum-leakage --
XPEB  ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1    nf=1
XNEB  ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.42 nf=1

* --- high-Vt supply header + local decoupling ------------------------------
XHDR  VDDI ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_hvt l=0.5 w=84 nf=12
XCDEC VDDI AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=158 l=158

* --- clock gate  NG = NAND(CLK,EN) = /CLK when enabled ---------------------
* EN sits on the bottom NMOS so the stack node parks at VDDI and the free
* running clock moves no charge out of AVDD while the pump is disabled.
XPG1  NG   CLK VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1    nf=1
XPG2  NG   EN  VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1    nf=1
XNG1  NG   CLK NMID AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.7  nf=1
XNG2  NMID EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.7  nf=1

* --- CKG = /NG = CLK (NG itself carries the opposite phase) ----------------
XPCK  CKG NG VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.4 nf=1
XNCK  CKG NG AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.7 nf=1

* --- make-before-break generator: Q1=NAND(CKG,DB), Q2=NAND(NG,DA) ----------
* Cross coupling from the far bottom plate keeps DA and DB from ever being
* low together; that state would turn both transfer PMOS on into two
* discharged flying caps and dump the pumped node.
XPQ1A Q1   CKG VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.4 nf=1
XPQ1B Q1   DB  VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.4 nf=1
XNQ1A Q1   CKG QM1  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.4 nf=1
XNQ1B QM1  DB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.4 nf=1

XPQ2A Q2   NG  VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.4 nf=1
XPQ2B Q2   DA  VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.4 nf=1
XNQ2A Q2   NG  QM2  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.4 nf=1
XNQ2B QM2  DA  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.4 nf=1

* --- bottom-plate buffers --------------------------------------------------
* Pre-driver is NMOS-strong and the output driver is PMOS-strong, so each
* plate rises quickly and falls slowly.  That biases the crossover towards
* both-plates-high, which is the harmless overlap state, at every corner.
XPA1  XA Q1 VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2 nf=1
XNA1  XA Q1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=5 nf=1
XPA2  DA XA VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=20  nf=4
XNA2  DA XA AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2.5 nf=1

XPB1  XB Q2 VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2 nf=1
XNB1  XB Q2 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=5 nf=1
XPB2  DB XB VDDI VDDI sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=20  nf=4
XNB2  DB XB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2.5 nf=1

* --- flying capacitors (~10 pF each) ---------------------------------------
XC1 DA N1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=71 l=71
XC2 DB N2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=71 l=71

* --- cross-coupled pre-charge of the top plates to AVDD (no Vt loss) -------
XMN1 N1 N2 AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMN2 N2 N1 AVDD AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* --- startup diodes --------------------------------------------------------
* The cross-coupled pair has a dead state with both gates low; these bias the
* top plates near AVDD-Vt so the pump always bootstraps, and they turn off
* once the top plates rise above AVDD.
XDS1 AVDD AVDD N1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XDS2 AVDD AVDD N2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* --- cross-coupled charge transfer into the pumped node --------------------
* High-Vt devices: the off-state gate-source bias of this topology is only
* about 0 V, so a standard-Vt switch would bleed the pumped node back into
* the idle flying cap at the hot fast corner.
XMP1 VP N2 N1 VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_hvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XMP2 VP N1 N2 VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_hvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4

* --- pumped-node reservoir -------------------------------------------------
XCVP VP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=158 l=158

* --- series dropping resistor: sets VOUT and filters the switching ripple ---
XRS VP VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=48

.ends charge_pump_unregulate

* Unregulated two-phase cross-coupled voltage doubler (VOUT ~ 2*AVDD - Iload*Rout)
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN(active high) VOUT
* Main switches get full-swing gate drive from two small unloaded auxiliary
* doublers: GN1/GN2 swing AVDD..2*AVDD (NMOS charge switches), GP1/GP2 swing
* VOUT-AVDD..VOUT (PMOS transfer switches).
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT
* ---- enable buffer: ENI = EN (restored)
XEN1P ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.84 nf=1
XEN1N ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XEN2P ENI ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.84 nf=1
XEN2N ENI ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
* ---- clock gate: G1 = NAND(CLK, ENI); G1 = 1 when disabled
XG1PA G1 CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1 nf=1

*=============================================================================
* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump with active-high enable
*
* Topology: two antiphase series-parallel (2:1) doubler branches sharing one
* output node.  Each branch is a flying MIM capacitor whose bottom plate is
* driven by one phase of the gated clock; its top plate is alternately tied to
* AVDD (charge phase, cross-coupled NMOS) and to the output node (deliver
* phase, cross-coupled PMOS).  The two branches deliver charge in opposite
* half-cycles, so the output is refreshed twice per clock period.
*
* The output level is set by charge balance, not by a device threshold:
*     VOUT = 2*AVDD - Iout/(2*f*Cfly) - Iout*Rout
* Iout/(2*f*Cfly) is fixed by the MIM capacitor (corner invariant, tc=0) and
* the clock frequency; Iout*Rout is fixed by the poly resistor and the fixed
* 50 uA load.  Both loss terms are therefore essentially PVT independent.
*
* Enable: EN low forces the gated clock static, shorts both flying nodes to
* AVSS and holds the clock-gate output high, so no switching node in the DUT
* sees any charge movement and no AVDD-to-AVSS path is left conducting.
*=============================================================================
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Enable inverter:  ENB = ~EN
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP_ENB ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMN_ENB ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clock gate:  CKB = ~(CLK & EN)
*   EN=1 -> CKB is the complement of CLK and drives the branch-B bottom plate.
*   EN=0 -> CKB is static at AVDD, so branch B sees no switching at all.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP_G1 CKB CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMP_G2 CKB EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMN_G1 CKB CLK GMID AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMN_G2 GMID EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clock input isolation gate (transmission gate, enabled by EN)
*   While EN=1 the full CLK swing reaches the branch-A bottom plate without
*   drawing any AVDD current (the external clock pin sources that charge).
*   While EN=0 the gate is off and CKA is clamped low, so no bottom plate
*   moves and no flying-node bounce can forward-bias a charge switch.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XTN CKA EN  CLK AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XTP CKA ENB CLK AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XMD CKA ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Flying capacitors (MIM, ~2 fF/um^2)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XCA FA CKA sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=55 l=55
XCB FB CKB sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=55 l=55

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Cross-coupled charge switches: pull the low flying node up to AVDD while
* the other branch is delivering (gate is the opposite flying node, which is
* boosted at that moment).
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XNA AVDD FB FA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNB AVDD FA FB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Cross-coupled delivery switches: connect the boosted flying node to VSUM
* while the other branch is charging.  Bulk tied to VSUM (the highest node of
* this pair) so no junction is ever forward biased in normal operation.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XPA VSUM FB FA VSUM sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XPB VSUM FA FB VSUM sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output series resistor: sets Iout*Rout of the output drop and spreads the
* delivery current over the phase, which keeps the output ripple small.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XR_OUT VSUM VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=47.7

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Disabled-state clamps: with EN=0 both flying nodes are held at AVSS so the
* CLK pin only drives a grounded capacitor and no AVDD path can conduct.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XDA FA ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XDB FB ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Small on-chip output capacitor
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XCO VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=30

.ends charge_pump_unregulate

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump, active-high enable
* Interface: AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT
*
* Cross-coupled voltage doubler.  Two flying capacitors are driven by
* complementary internal clocks.  Each top plate is recharged to AVDD by an
* NMOS switch whose gate is bootstrapped to about 2*AVDD, then stacked on top
* of the clock swing and dumped into VOUT through a cross-coupled PMOS.
* The bootstrapped gate keeps the recharge independent of VOUT, so the pump
* behaves as a charge source of C*(AVDD + Vclk - VOUT) per half cycle from
* start-up on, and the output settles where that equals the load current.
* Transfer PMOS wells go to VOUT (highest node) so their junctions are only
* ever forward biased in the intended transfer direction.
* EN=0 gates both internal clocks low, grounds the bootstrap nodes and holds
* both flying nodes at AVSS, leaving only off-device leakage.

.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* enb = NOT(EN)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP_ENB enb EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN_ENB enb EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* clk_i = NOR(CLK, enb) ;  clkb_i = NOT(clk_i)
*   enabled : clk_i = NOT(CLK), clkb_i = CLK
*   disabled: clk_i = 0 (driven low), clkb_i = AVDD (driven high)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump with active-high enable.

*        source-bulk body diode never conducts in reverse.

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump with active-high enable.
* AVDD/AVSS: supply (1.8 V).  CLK: 10 MHz rail-to-rail clock.  EN: active-high.
* VOUT: doubled output (bench drives 1 nF + 50 uA load to ground).
*
* Topology: all-NMOS cross-coupled doubler.  The two flying nodes are
* precharged to AVDD through NMOS switches whose gates are bootstrapped by the
* opposite flying node, so VOUT = 2*AVDD - Vth(diode) (one diode drop instead
* of two, keeping VOUT inside [2.2, 2.8] at every corner).
*
* The bottom plates are driven by a non-overlapping two-phase clock generator.
* Each phase rises only after the other has fallen, so a precharge switch is
* always fully off before its flying node is boosted.  This eliminates the
* C_fly*AVDD shoot-through that the naive two-NAND gate otherwise burns.
*
* With EN=0 the generator forces both bottom plates to AVDD (their wide PMOS
* pull-ups are on, Vds=0) and nothing toggles, so only sub-threshold leakage
* of a handful of minimum-width PMOS remains (well under the 100 nA budget).

* nclk = ~(CLK & EN)          -> held at AVDD when EN=0, no toggling

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump, active-high enable.
* Pins: AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT

* Single-flying-capacitor doubler with non-overlapping clock.
*   charge phase (ck=0): PMOS MPIN on, node n = AVDD, Cf charged to ~AVDD.
*   pump   phase (ck=1): MPIN off, n bootstrapped to ~2*AVDD, diode MNDO
*                        dumps charge into VOUT.
*   VOUT ~= 2*AVDD - Vdiode - Iload/(f*Cf)
*
* Non-overlap: the switch gate (S) and the flying-cap bottom plate (B) are
* both gated copies of CLK, but S sees only the tiny MOS gate while B sees the
* ~20 pF flying cap.  S therefore turns MPIN off almost instantly, and B rises
* only after an RC delay set by the transmission-gate on-resistance and Cf.
* Both S and B are charged from the external clock source (through the TGs),
* so the flying-cap switching current is not drawn from AVDD.
*
* MPIN bulk is tied to its drain (n), which is always >= source (AVDD), so the
* drain/body diode never forward-biases during the pump phase.
*
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT

XMNEN enb EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XMPS S enb CLK AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

XMNPB B enb AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump, active-high enable.
* Two-phase interleaved doubler:
*   - g5v0 nfet input switches, gates driven by buffered EN: when enabled
*     they act as gated diodes (one Vth drop sets the doubled output),
*     when disabled they are fully off.
*   - cross-coupled g5v0 pfet output switches, nwells tied to VOUT.
*   - MIM flying caps clocked by complementary gated phases.
*   - clock buffer, gating NANDs and tapered drivers run from a switched
*     rail VDDD behind an HVT pfet header (gate = ENB); with EN=0 the
*     whole clock tree is unpowered (no crowbar, no switching), leaving
*     only the small EN buffer and header leakage on AVDD.
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT
* --- always-on enable buffer: ENB = ~EN, ENG = EN (long-L, low leakage) ---
XENB0 ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_hvt l=2 w=2 nf=1
XENB1 ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
XENG0 ENG ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_hvt l=2 w=2 nf=1
XENG1 ENG ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
* --- power-gating header for the clock tree (on when EN=1) ---
XHDR VDDD ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_hvt l=0.15 w=60 nf=10
* --- clock input buffer on switched rail: CK = CLK, NCK = ~CLK ---
XCKB0 CK CLK VDDD VDDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XCKB1 CK CLK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XCKB2 NCK CK VDDD VDDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XCKB3 NCK CK AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
* --- gating (switched rail):
*     UA  = NAND(ENG,CK)   -> driver chain -> CLKA = ENG & CK
*     UB  = NAND(ENG,NCK)  -> driver chain -> CLKB = ENG & ~CK
*     disabled: VDDD=0, clock tree unpowered ---
* NAND2 UA: pfets parallel (bulk VDDD), nfets series
XNUA0 UA ENG VDDD VDDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XNUA1 UA CK VDDD VDDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XNUA2 UA ENG NA0 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump with active-high enable.
*
* Topology: two interleaved doubler branches on opposite clock phases.
* Each branch, during its own half cycle:
*   - recharge: the flying capacitor's bottom plate sits at AVSS while a
*     PMOS input switch (gate on its own phase) ties the top plate to AVDD,
*     so the capacitor recharges to the full supply every cycle with no
*     threshold drop and no dependence on the other branch.  Start-up
*     therefore cannot deadlock at any PVT corner.
*   - transfer: the phase driver raises the bottom plate to AVDD, lifting
*     the top plate toward 2*AVDD, and a 5 V-gate PMOS output switch (gate
*     on the opposite phase) connects the top plate to VOUT for the whole
*     half cycle, dumping essentially all the delivered charge into VOUT.
* The loaded output follows the charge balance
*     VOUT ~ 2*AVDD - ILOAD/(2*f*Cfly),
* which is set by the MIM capacitance and the load, so it is stable over
* process and temperature; interleaving halves the output sawtooth.
*
* Phase generation: NAND(CLK,EN) drives the phase-B node directly and one
* inverter drives the phase-A node, so both flying-capacitor bottom plates
* are driven push-pull by sized static-CMOS gates with sub-nanosecond
* edges.  The inverter delay also gives each output switch break-before-
* make timing: at every transition the rectifier gate swings before its own
* bottom plate falls, so the output capacitor is never back-pumped into a
* falling flying node, and each rectifier turns on before its bottom plate
* rises.  Fast phase edges keep the input switch's reverse conduction
* (charge lost back into AVDD during the bottom-plate rise, ~tau_edge/Ron)
* in the tens of femtocoulombs.
*
* Enable: with EN low the NAND output rests static high, the phase-A
* inverter output rests static low, and every switch sits in a static,
* zero-current state, so disabled supply current is leakage only.  The
* small diode-connected devices precharge the flying nodes and VOUT at
* start-up and give the bench a DC path.
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT
* phase generator: PHIB = NAND(CLK, EN); PHIA = NOT(PHIB)
XNAN_P1 PHIB CLK AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNAN_P2 PHIB EN  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNAN_N1 PHIB CLK NN  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNAN_N2 NN  EN  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XINV_N  PHIA PHIB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XINV_P  PHIA PHIB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
* branch A: input switch, output switch, precharge diode, flying capacitor
XPA     VA  PHIA AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=5 nf=1
XP2A    VOUT PHIB VA  VA  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XDA     VA  VA  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XCA     VA  PHIA sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=38
* branch B: input switch, output switch, precharge diode, flying capacitor
XPB     VB  PHIB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=5 nf=1
XP2B    VOUT PHIA VB  VB  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4

* Single-clock unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump with active-high enable.

* clock rail CLKI; NMOS M1 (gate=EN) precharges pump node X from AVDD while
* CLKI is low; the MIM flying cap C1 couples X up by the full clock swing; the

* AVSS, so the precharge switch never conducts and the only AVDD current is
* junction/subthreshold leakage while the external clock keeps running.

XTG_P CLKI ENB CLK AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump, active-high enable.
* Topology: single flying capacitor (Dickson doubler cell). D1 pumps the
* flying node up from AVDD without a body-diode clamp (bulk to AVSS), so the
* boosted node reaches AVDD + clock swing. D2 rectifies to VOUT with bulk
* tied to its source to avoid body-effect loss. EN gates the clock to the
* flying cap through a transmission gate; with EN=0 the cap node is held low

XNENB ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
* Clock transmission gate: passes CLK to the flying-cap node when EN=1.
XTGN CN1 EN CLK AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XTGP CN1 ENB CLK AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
* Pulldown holds the flying-cap node low when EN=0.
XPD CN1 ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
* Flying capacitor (~1 nF).
XC1 CN1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=32
* Pump diode D1: AVDD -> N1, bulk to substrate (no forward clamp on N1).
XD1 AVDD AVDD N1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=8
* Output diode D2: N1 -> VOUT, bulk tied to source (no body effect on the output drop).
XD2 N1 N1 VOUT VOUT sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=8

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump, active-high enable.
* Topology: switch PREFED pump node X (PFET switch passes full AVDD to X,
*   drain-bulk junction clamps the X peak), diode D2 (bulk tied to its drain
*   X -> zero body effect on the output diode). Only one body-effect-free

* Built only from Sky130 PDK devices (MOS + MIM caps).
*   EN=0: AVDD feed cut (B=0), pump nodes clamped to AVSS -> no supply current.
*   EN=1: CLK switch-pumps X; D2 transfers charge to VOUT.
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT
* Enable inverter: ENB = ~EN, powered from AVDD/AVSS (static in both states).
XNINV ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPINV ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XPB B ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

* Pump node X clamped to AVSS when disabled.

* Flying capacitor C1 between CLK and node X.
XC1 CLK X sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=600 l=250 mult=1
* Output diode D2: X -> VOUT, bulk tied to drain X (no body effect;

* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump, active-high enable (v4).

* clamps VOUT near AVDD+|Vthp|.

*    no charge steal-back from the boosted node.
*  - CLK drives the flying capacitor bottom plate directly (through the
*    specified 50 ohm bench source resistance).
.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT
* ---- enable inverter (ENB = ~EN), AVDD domain ----
XPENB ENB EN AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XNENB ENB EN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
* ---- power header: VDDP present only when EN=1 ----
XHD VDDP ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=56 nf=8
* ---- doubler core ----
* input diode: charges N1 toward VDDP - |Vth| while CLK is low
XDM1 N1 N1 VDDP VDDP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=98 nf=14
* flying capacitor between CLK and N1
XC1 N1 CLK sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100
* output diode: delivers boosted charge to VOUT
XDM2 VOUT VOUT N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=98 nf=14
* on-chip output reservoir, halves ripple across the external 1 nF load cap
XCOUT VOUT AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=1000

circuit:
* Unregulated voltage-doubling charge pump with active-high enable.
*
* Two-phase switched-capacitor doubler:
*   charge phase   (chg): Cfly top plate to AVDD, bottom plate to AVSS
*   transfer phase (xfr): bottom plate to AVDD, top plate to VOUT
* Operating point in the full-transfer regime is set by charge balance,
*   VOUT ~ 2*AVDD - Iload/(2*fclk*Cfly),
* which is PVT-robust because Cfly is a MIM cap against a fixed load and
* clock.  The high-side power switches are 5V PMOS whose gates are level
* shifted up to a bootstrapped rail vbst (~2*AVDD), generated on chip by a
* cross-coupled doubler, so they turn off against the >AVDD top-plate
* swing; their n-wells tie to vbst, the highest steady potential.  The
* phase generator is gated by EN at its inputs, so with EN low no
* AVDD-supplied node toggles and all power switches are quiescent.

* ---- local logic cells (all sky130_fd_pr__*fet_01v8) ----

.subckt cpinv a y vp vn
XP y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
.ends cpinv

.subckt cpinv2 a y vp vn
XP y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.6 nf=1
.ends cpinv2

.subckt cpinv4 a y vp vn
XP y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends cpinv4

.subckt cpnand2 a b y vp vn
XP1 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP2 y b vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XN1 y a nmid vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XN2 nmid b vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
.ends cpnand2

.subckt cpnor2 a b y vp vn
XP1 pmid a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XP2 y b pmid vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XN1 y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XN2 y b vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
.ends cpnor2

* ---- level shifter: non-inverting, input swings 0..vp-vn rail, ----
* ---- output swings 0..vb.  Cross-coupled PMOS pair.             ----

.subckt cpls in inb out vb vn
XN1 ni in vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XN2 out inb vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XP1 ni out vb vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XP2 out ni vb vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
.ends cpls

* ---- cross-coupled doubler generating the bootstrap rail ----

.subckt cpbst ckh ckl vb vn
XC1 n1 ckh sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=15 l=15 mult=1
XC2 n2 ckl sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=15 l=15 mult=1
XP1 vb n2 n1 vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XP2 vb n1 n2 vb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XC vb vn sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=30 mult=1
.ends cpbst

* ---- top-level pump ----

.subckt charge_pump_unregulate AVDD AVSS CLK EN VOUT

* Enable-gated clock rails: both are static low when EN=0, so no
* AVDD-supplied node switches in the disabled state.
* clk_e  = CLK & EN   (NAND + INV)
* clk_eb = ~CLK & EN  = NOR(CLK, ~EN)   -- NOR output already has the
* correct polarity; no extra inverter (one would flip it into overlap).
XNA CLK EN na AVDD AVSS cpnand2
XIA na clk_e AVDD AVSS cpinv
XEB EN enb AVDD AVSS cpinv
XNB CLK enb clk_eb AVDD AVSS cpnor2

* Buffered copies drive the bootstrap pump and the delay chains.
XB1 clk_e cke1 AVDD AVSS cpinv2
XB2 cke1 ck AVDD AVSS cpinv4
XB3 clk_eb ckbe1 AVDD AVSS cpinv2
XB4 ckbe1 ckb AVDD AVSS cpinv4

* Delayed copies set the break-before-make dead time.
XD1 ck d1 AVDD AVSS cpinv
XD2 d1 ck_d AVDD AVSS cpinv
XD3 ckb e1 AVDD AVSS cpinv
XD4 e1 ckb_d AVDD AVSS cpinv

* chg = ck AND ck_d ; xfr = ckb AND ckb_d (never overlap).
XNC ck ck_d nc AVDD AVSS cpnand2
XIC nc chg AVDD AVSS cpinv2
XND ckb ckb_d nd AVDD AVSS cpnand2
XID nd xfr AVDD AVSS cpinv2
XCB chg chgb AVDD AVSS cpinv4
XFB xfr xfrb AVDD AVSS cpinv4

* Bootstrap supply (about 2*AVDD) from a cross-coupled doubler clocked by
* the enable-gated clocks; it holds a static value when EN is low.
XBP ck ckb vbst AVSS cpbst

* Level-shifted gate drives for the high-side power switches:
* low while the switch must conduct, vbst (~2*AVDD) while it must block.
XLS2 chgb chg s2g vbst AVSS cpls
XLS3 xfrb xfr s3g vbst AVSS cpls

* Power stage.
* Charge phase (chg=1): S1 pulls bp to AVSS, S2 charges tp to AVDD.
* Transfer phase (xfr=1): S4 pulls bp to AVDD, S3 connects tp to VOUT.
XS1 bp chg AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XS4 bp xfrb AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XS2 tp s2g AVDD vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XS3 tp s3g VOUT vbst sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* Flying capacitor sets the output impedance 1/(2*f*Cfly).
XCFLY tp bp sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=36 l=36 mult=1

.ends charge_pump_unregulate
